_readme: Template for workspace.config.json. /init-workspace fills in a copy for your company; the real file is git-ignored and never shared. Credentials do NOT go here: put them in ~/.qa-global/.env (or the file named by QA_SECRETS_FILE).
issueTracker: <Jira | Azure DevOps | Linear | GitHub Issues | other>

issueTrackerOptions.notes: <tracker-specific rules, e.g. which issue type is a sub-task>

testTool: <Qmetry | TestRail | Zephyr | Xray | Azure Test Plans | spreadsheet-only | other>
docsPlatform: <Notion | Confluence | SharePoint | Google Docs | wiki | other>
localization: <e.g. English only, or the product's languages incl. any right-to-left one>
